contentEn:
A complete whole-house renovation in Maple Ridge costs between $90,000 and $380,000 in 2026, depending on scope, condition, and finishes. A single-bathroom refresh starts around $22,000; a full-home gut renovation with new kitchen, bathrooms, flooring, and exterior updates typically lands between $180,000 and $380,000. Reno Stars has completed whole-house projects in Maple Ridge, Richmond, and across Metro Vancouver — all with real contracts and verified final costs.

What Determines Your Maple Ridge Renovation Budget?

Three factors shape every whole-house renovation quote in Maple Ridge: the scope of work, the condition of the existing structure, and the finishes you choose. A 1980s character home with outdated electrical and plumbing requires more upfront work than a 2000s home in good condition — this alone can add $30,000–$80,000 to a project. Finish selections also swing the total significantly: mid-range porcelain tile and laminate flooring keep costs in the $120,000–$180,000 band, while heated marble floors and custom millwork can push a project past $300,000.

Maple Ridge Whole-House Renovation Cost by Scope (2026)

Reno Stars tracks actual project costs across Maple Ridge and the surrounding Metro Vancouver area. These figures come from real contracts signed in 2025–2026:

  • Single-bathroom refresh (tile, fixtures, paint, vanity): $22,000–$35,000
  • Two-bathroom renovation (full rip-and-replace both bathrooms): $45,000–$75,000
  • Kitchen renovation (cabinetry, countertops, appliances, lighting): $38,000–$85,000
  • Main floor renovation (kitchen, bathroom, flooring, paint throughout): $75,000–$140,000
  • Whole-house renovation (gut all floors, new kitchen, bathrooms, flooring, exterior touch-up): $180,000–$380,000

How Long Does a Whole-House Renovation Take in Maple Ridge?

A Maple Ridge whole-house renovation takes 3 to 9 months from permit approval to final inspection, depending on scope. A single-floor refresh of a relatively modern home can wrap in 6–10 weeks. A full-house gut of a character home in Maple Ridge — where hidden structural issues are common in 1970s–80s builds — typically requires 5 to 9 months. All Reno Stars whole-house projects in 2025 completed on or within 2 weeks of the contracted timeline, based on final inspection sign-off dates.

Maple Ridge Permit Requirements for Whole-House Renovations

Maple Ridge falls under the BC Building Code and the Township of Maple Ridge building bylaw. A full-house renovation that involves structural changes, electrical rewire, or plumbing rerouting requires a building permit. Electrical upgrades to meet 2025 BC Electrical Code cost $3,000–$12,000 as a standalone item. Plumbing repiping adds $5,000–$18,000. These are typically included in the overall contract price but appear as separate line items in the permit valuation — the Township of Maple Ridge uses the declared value to calculate permit fees, which run approximately 1% of the construction value.

FAQ — Maple Ridge Whole-House Renovation

What does a whole-house renovation cost in Maple Ridge in 2026?

Most whole-house renovations in Maple Ridge cost between $90,000 and $380,000 in 2026. The wide range reflects scope: a single-floor refresh starts around $75,000, while a complete gut renovation of all floors typically lands $180,000–$380,000. Finish level, existing home condition, and whether structural work is needed are the main variables.

Does Maple Ridge require a permit for whole-house renovation?

Yes. Any whole-house renovation involving structural changes, electrical upgrades, or plumbing work in Maple Ridge requires a building permit from the Township of Maple Ridge. Permit fees are approximately 1% of the declared construction value. Reno Stars handles permit applications as part of its standard project management service.

How long does a whole-house renovation take in Maple Ridge?

A whole-house renovation in Maple Ridge takes 3 to 9 months from permit approval to final inspection. A two-bathroom plus kitchen renovation on one floor typically takes 3–4 months. A full-house gut including electrical repaneling, plumbing rerouting, and exterior updates typically requires 5–9 months. The Township of Maple Ridge building department turn-around for simple permits is 10–15 business days.

Should I renovate my Maple Ridge home room-by-room or all at once?

Doing the work all at once costs 15–25% less than room-by-room over time, because you only set up the site once, order materials in bulk, and avoid repeating trade mobilizations. The main floor and both bathrooms together typically represent the highest-value all-at-once package for Maple Ridge homeowners. Reno Stars offers a project phasing plan for clients who need to sequence work around budget milestones.

What adds the most value to a Maple Ridge home renovation?

In Maple Ridge's current market, a renovated kitchen recouped 75–85% of its cost in resale value based on comparable transactions in 2024–2025. A second fully renovated bathroom adds 8–12% in most neighbourhoods. The combination of kitchen plus two-bathroom renovation on the main floor typically delivers the strongest return-per-dollar for Maple Ridge homeowners planning to sell within five years.

哪些因素影響 Maple Ridge 裝修預算？

三個主要因素決定 Maple Ridge 全屋裝修報價：工程範圍、現有結構狀況及用料選擇。1980年代的房屋水管和電線老化，裝修前期工程成本比2000年代狀況良好的房屋高出 $30,000 至 $80,000。用料方面，拋光瓷磚配複合木地板保持在 $120,000–$180,000 水平；而暖炕大理石地板及訂製木工則可將項目造價推高至 $300,000 以上。

Maple Ridge 全屋裝修需要多長時間？

Maple Ridge 全屋裝修從許可證批准到最終驗收需時 3 至 9 個月，視乎工程範圍。對於狀況相對良好的房屋，單層翻新可在 6–10 週內完成。對於 Maple Ridge 常見的 1970–80 年代特色住宅，由於隱藏結構問題較多，全面翻新通常需要 5–9 個月。聚星裝修 2025 年所有全屋翻新項目均在合約工期內或最多延遲兩週完成，以最終驗收日期為準。

Maple Ridge 全屋翻新許可證要求

Maple Ridge 隸屬卑詩省建築規範及 Maple Ridge 鎮政府建築附例。任何涉及結構改動、電線更新或水管重新佈線的全屋翻新工程，均需向 Maple Ridge 鎮政府申請建築許可證。符合 2025 年卑詩電氣規範的電線升級工程費用為 $3,000 至 $12,000（獨立項目）。水管重新鋪設另加 $5,000 至 $18,000。聚星裝修將這些項目列為許可證估價的單獨項目，Maple Ridge 鎮政府按工程申報價值計算許可證費用，約為工程造價的 1%。

常見問題 — Maple Ridge 全屋裝修

2026 年 Maple Ridge 全屋裝修費用是多少？

2026 年 Maple Ridge 大部分全屋裝修費用介乎 $90,000 至 $380,000。造價差異源於工程範圍：單層翻新由約 $75,000 起；全面拆掉所有樓層翻新通常在 $180,000 至 $380,000 之間。房屋現況、是否需要結構工程及用料檔次是主要變數。

Maple Ridge 全屋翻新需要申請許可證嗎？

需要。任何涉及結構改動、電線升級或水管重新佈線的全屋翻新工程，均需向 Maple Ridge 鎮政府申請建築許可證。許可證費用約為工程造價的 1%。聚星裝修提供許可證申請服務，作為標準項目管理的一部分。

Maple Ridge 全屋裝修需要多長時間？

Maple Ridge 全屋裝修從許可證批准到最終驗收需時 3 至 9 個月。兩間浴室加廚房的單層翻新工程通常需時 3–4 個月。包含電線重鋪、水管重新佈線及外牆更新的全屋翻新工程通常需 5–9 個月。Maple Ridge 鎮政府對簡單許可證的審批時間為 10–15 個工作天。

應該一次過翻新還是分房間陸續裝修？

一次過完成比陸續翻新可節省 15–25% 成本，因為您只需設置施工場地一次，物料一次性採購，亦避免重複動員工匠的費用。對 Maple Ridge 業主而言，主層加兩間浴室的組合通常是性價比最高的方案。聚星裝修為需要在預算範圍內分期施工的客戶提供分階段工程方案。

Maple Ridge 房屋裝修中哪些項目增值最多？

按 2024–2025 年 Maple Ridge 市場可比成交數據分析，翻新廚房的轉售價值回報率為 75–85%。第二間全翻新浴室在大部分社區可額外增值 8–12%。主層廚房加兩間浴室翻新組合，通常是 Maple Ridge 計劃在五年內轉售物業的業主最具價值的裝修方案。
